harnessNote: Contract-level checks drive the REAL NFTBonfire (owner = harness; dummy nftMinter/antimatter addresses; burn() not exercised). Setters are used as the checkpoint trigger. T0 = 1_700_000_000.

proofs.property: maxPayout != 0 => pendingPayout() <= maxPayout (fresh checkpoint, then dt elapsed)
proofs.domain: rate < 2^128, dt < 2^64, cap any nonzero uint256
proofs.note: Structural: follows directly from the explicit clamp `if (cap != 0 && raw > cap) return cap`. True identity, not a finding.

proofs.property: pot accrued under cap0 (any, incl. 0), owner sets cap1 != 0 (checkpoint), more time passes => pendingPayout() <= cap1
proofs.domain: rate < 2^128, dt0,dt1 < 2^40, cap0 any, cap1 nonzero
proofs.note: Confirms a stored pot above a newly-lowered cap is still clamped on read. Not a finding.

proofs.property: _checkpoint (via setMaxPayout(sameCap)) at t: accruedStored == pendingPayout_before, lastUpdate == t, pendingPayout_after == pendingPayout_before (no value created/destroyed)
setRatePerDay(newRate) at t leaves pendingPayout() at t unchanged (checkpoint at OLD rate and OLD cap)

concrete boundary: at dt = 100*365 days, rate = floor(uint256.max/dt) = 36717430630808027468154168254911183362909051454097083980041090819353 (~3.67e67) does not revert; rate+1 reverts (checked-mul Panic 0x11)
proofs.note: Confirms profile LOCAL-003 threshold. Thresholds by window: 1y 3.67e69, 10y 3.67e68, 100y 3.67e67, 1000y 3.67e66 (python, exact floor). A realistic 18-dp rate (e.g. 1e30 = 1e12 tokens/day) is ~37 orders of magnitude below. Overflow requires an absurd owner input; obvious-misconfig, Law 3 trusted - not a finding.

unverified.note: Property: q1+q2 <= q and q-(q1+q2) <= 1. Nonlinear e*r constraints stall the solver even with division removed. NOT proven - manual argument: (m1+m2) < 2D so q - q1 - q2 = floor((m1+m2)/D) in {0,1}.
Bounded retry also timed out at 60s. NOT proven.
Three symbolic divisions (checkpoint, read, reference). Intractable as expected. NOT proven.

Solidity checked-mul overflow guard compiles to a division-based check, so the solver stalls. NOT proven symbolically - analytic bound: dt*rate < 2^192, /86400 then + pot (<2^193) cannot overflow 2^256; boundary itself confirmed concretely by check_overflowBoundaryAt100y.
